title: Women's Christmas – Santa Gets All the Credit Crewneck Sweatshirt

seo.title: Christmas Sweatshirt for Wife – Santa Gets All the Credit
seo.description: Christmas sweatshirt for wife: a gift with a pink bow, tape and scissors under SANTA GETS ALL THE CREDIT. Women's crewneck in Sand or Navy, S–3XL.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

Santa gets all the credit, and she did the wrapping. This Christmas sweatshirt for wife is for the woman who ran the whole holiday and wears it on Christmas morning while everyone thanks the man in red.

The art is a red gift box tied with a big pink coquette bow, a nearly empty tape dispenser on one side and a pair of pink-handled scissors on the other, with holly sprigs scattered around. SANTA GETS runs across the top in heavy cherry red capitals (cream on Navy) and ALL THE CREDIT across the bottom in pine green with a pink edge (pink with a cream edge on Navy).

Wear it for wrapping night, the family breakfast and the cookie swap, or give it to the wife who did it all: a partner looking for Christmas gifts for wife can wrap it with a note. Printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex crewneck sweatshirt fit
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband; no hood, no pockets
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 2 colors: Sand, Navy

Questions

How does the Santa Gets All the Credit crewneck fit?
This classic unisex Gildan 18000 crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. comes in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomy, cozy look over a long-sleeve tee. If the size is off, we offer one free size exchange within 30 days of delivery.

What is it made of and how warm is it?
The Santa Gets All the Credit crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. is 50% cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz per square yard, with a ribbed collar, cuffs and waistband and no hood. It is a mid-weight, cozy layer for wrapping night and cold walks. Machine wash cold inside out and tumble dry low.

What colors does it come in and how is it printed?
It comes in Sand and Navy, both in sizes S through 3XL. On Sand the headline is cherry red and the second line pine green with a pink edge; on Navy the headline turns cream and the second line pink so every word stays clear. Graphic Tees Co. prints each one to order.

Is this a good gift for a wife who does all the wrapping?
Yes. The Santa Gets All the Credit crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. is a gift for the woman who wrapped every present, from a partner, a grown kid or a sister, and orders over $45 ship free. The free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess.

When should I order for Christmas?
Order by about December 8 so the Santa Gets All the Credit crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. arrives before Christmas. Each sweatshirt is printed to order, which takes a few business days, then ships within the US. Orders of $45 or more ship free, and a misprint or damaged item is reprinted or refunded within 30 days.
